title: TYT Platform Architecture
content: High-level architecture of TYT Platform v2 (loader, entity libs, projects).

items.title: Loader (tyt.js)
items.how: Projects set srcConfig; loader sets directories and runs lib/index

items.title: Shared libs (entity/)
items.how: Generic naming, ES5, no project coupling

items.title: Projects/ www/
items.what: Each project has www with define.js, index.html/css, src/

items.title: Data-driven docs
items.how: Loaded via dataLoader, rendered via render helpers
